name: manual_aacaf5
claim: Supersedes 7fe89fda8b0c: ensure_control_plane_token restores an available persisted token when the environment token is absent; it generates a token only when both sources are absent and authentication is enforced. Directional tokens are supported: outbound peer token takes precedence and the receiver validates its own accepted lane tokens. A shared token is one option; rotate credentials out of band.

decisions.notes: orchestrator/control_plane_auth.py: persisted-token restoration and directional token selection.

rationale: orchestrator/control_plane_auth.py: persisted-token restoration and directional token selection.
